# read data
vv_arr = vv.read(1)
season_arr = season.read(1)
dem_arr = dem.read(1)
# compute slope (simple finite difference)
px, py = vv.res  # pixel size
# gradient
dz_dx = np.gradient(dem_arr, px, axis=1)
dz_dy = np.gradient(dem_arr, py, axis=0)
slope_rad = np.arctan(np.sqrt(dz_dx**2 + dz_dy**2))
slope_deg = np.degrees(slope_rad)

# clip mask to polygon
